sentences.text: Oh, the night began quietly, yet I felt the machines waking up deep within the house starting at 00:10.
The air thickened immediately as the appliance energy started to pulse above.
I sensed a sudden, overwhelming presence, for the observed energy of 90 Wh was far higher than the anticipated 40 Wh.
This intense wave of power washed through the house, a chill vibrating through my tiny ghost form.
The mysterious reading lingered, holding the air captive until the energy finally dissipated at 00:30.
